title: Kitne Door Kitne Paas
desc: After studying in New York City, Jatin (Fardeen Khan) is returning home to India, where he's set to marry a woman from his hometown. On his flight to Delhi, he meets Karishma (Amrita Arora), coincidentally on her way to her own marriage, and her quick temper instantly sets them at odds. Once in Delhi, the unlikely travel companions find their connecting flight has been cancelled, so Jatin and Karishma must share a long bus ride to Gujarat, discovering each other and themselves in the process.

title: Filhaal
desc: When Sia watches her best friend Rewa slip into depression because of her inability to bear a child, she offers to be her surrogate. Trouble brews when jealousy finds its way into their relationship.

title: Shootout At Wadala
desc: A crime-action film based on a true story. The movie depicts the rise of a gangster, who becomes a force to be reckoned within Mumbai's criminal underworld. It also highlights the police's efforts to capture him and the infamous shootout that took place in Wadala- Mumbai. The film features themes of power, revenge, and justice in a gritty and violent setting.

title: Koi Aap Sa
desc: A film that centers around a young man who develops feelings for his childhood friend, who is already in a committed relationship. As he tries to move on, he falls in love with another woman. However, things become complicated when his childhood friend realizes her own feelings for him.

title: Pyar Ki Takkar (dub) (aranmanai Kaavalan -Tamil)
desc: A large family returns to an ancestral property (palace) to sell it off. Meanwhile they discover some supernatural elements in the palace.
